items.label: A pen in the barn with a raised bed, out of draughts; the outdoor kennel for later
A blanket with the smell of her litter (ask the breeder)
Heavy food and water bowls that do not tip over
The same puppy food the breeder uses, for the first days
A soft collar with an ID tag and a light leash
Chew toys and a tug toy, as an alternative to biting
A safe area: close off the workshop, tools, chemicals and cables
A vet appointment for the first week
Family rules: the same word for each cue, who feeds her and where she sleeps
Enzymatic cleaner and bags for accidents
items.hint: Enzymatic cleaner breaks down the smell of pee and poop, so she does not go back to the same spot. Do not use bleach or ammonia: they smell like urine. The bags are for picking up poop.
